title: Simplification of Via-first TSV and Backside Interconnect Process for Large-Scale Superconducting Quantum Annealing Circuits
orgs: National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology (AIST);NEC Corporation
notes: Manual IMAPS download. Via-first TSV (60 um, 395 um deep) plus Ti-Nb-Ti backside wiring in 100 mm HR-Si, 11 steps vs 13 conventional; cavity resonance suppressed at 4 K.

title: Heterogeneous Integration Enabled by 3-D Stitch-Chips
notes: Fused-silica pitch-transition CPW stitch-chip plus Si TSV chiplet joins 200 um-pitch dummy chip to 300 um-pitch fused-silica board; Ka-band RL >16 dB, IL <1.3 dB; wire-bond baseline.

title: Analysis of Pattern Distortion by Panel Deformation and Addressing it by Using Extremely Large Exposure Field Fine-Resolution Lithography
